string-array.name: video_quality_labels
string-array.item: 1080p HEVC converted on the tablet (better, about 3× larger)

string-array.name: video_quality_lower
string-array.item: Videos on the tablet will be replaced by Google\'s 1080p version wherever it\'s smaller. They lose some sharpness, and getting it back later means downloading every video again.

Original videos on the tablet will be converted to 1080p HEVC. Videos above 1080p lose resolution and every converted video loses a little quality; getting the originals back later means downloading them all again.

string-array.name: video_quality_higher
string-array.item: Each video\'s original will be downloaded again and converted on the tablet. This takes a long time, uses a lot of data and about 3× the space of Google\'s version.
Every video will be downloaded again as its original file. This uses a lot of data, and originals can take 5 to 10 times the space.

string-array.name: photo_format_lower
string-array.item: Photos on the tablet will be replaced by Google\'s WebP version. It\'s compressed harder, so fine detail can soften slightly, and going back later means downloading every photo again.

string-array.name: photo_format_higher
string-array.item: Every photo will be downloaded again as JPEG, using about 70% more space.
